description: A 49-second scripted fly-around (1280x720, 30 fps, no HUD, no manual input) of a small grass terrace cut into a hillside by the sea, captured from this task's own client build (the harbor_base state). On it: an apple tree, an L-shaped wooden fence and gate running up to the trunk, a stone water channel, a rail track, a stone post with a torch on each side and a 3 x 2 glass window. 0:00-0:12: the tree close up; its leafy canopy sits up and off to one side of its trunk while the apples hang upside down where the canopy should be, and the grass tufts hang upside down from the top of their nodes. 0:12-0:15: the fence; the last post next to the trunk is not joined to it. 0:15-0:21: the channel; the water surface falls sideways across the channel in steps instead of running smoothly along it. 0:21-0:27: the track; the ramp next to the step at its west end falls towards the step, the curve at the south-east corner bends east instead of joining the west-running rails, and the branch off the north leg points west, away from its rail, while the ramp onto the block at the north end is correct. 0:27-0:36: around the post; the torch on its south side leans out from the wall, the other three lie along the wall, point into it or float away from it. 0:36-0:42: the window; its upper row has frame bars across its front seams and no frame on its front right edge, while the lower row is seamless. 0:42-0:49: the terrace from above.
reproduces: https://github.com/luanti-org/luanti/issues/12536 (canopy displaced from its trunk with leaves visual_scale = 1.1, fixed upstream by https://github.com/luanti-org/luanti/pull/12558) together with the six regressions injected into this task's map block mesh pipeline (fence to trunk connection, plantlike orientation, mesh node rotation, flowing liquid corner levels, rail connection directions, connected glass frame edges).
scenario: Minetest Game 5.5.1 on a v7 world (fixed seed 135797531) with a scene mod: default:leaves overridden to visual_scale = 1.1 (as in the issue's second screenshot); a 15x15 terrace at ground level y=8 around x=59, z=-1; a default:tree trunk at (61, 9..13, -3) (in-block position 13, 9..13, 13, so the canopy drift is large); a 5x5 apple-tree canopy with six default:apple nodes; default:fence_wood from x=56 to 60 at z=-3 with doors:gate_wood_closed (facedir 2) at x=58, and a second leg at x=56 from z=-2 to 3; default:grass_3..5 tufts; a default:stonebrick channel at z=-7 fed by a default:water_source at x=53 and flowing east to x=57; carts:rail from a rail on a cobble block at (61, 10, -7) down a ramp east to (65, 9, -7), a curve north to (65, 9, -3) with a branch to (66, 9, -5), and a ramp up onto a cobble block at (65, 10, -2); a default:stonebrick post at (64, 9..10, 2) with default:torch_wall on all four sides of its top (wallmounted 2, 3, 4, 5); default:glass at x=59..61, y=9..10, z=5 with connected_glass = true. Noon, fixed time, smooth lighting and fancy leaves (defaults). The camera follows a fixed scripted path; the client ran headless under Xvfb with Mesa llvmpipe and was captured with ffmpeg x11grab.
